problem.title: CT-ICP KITTI Odom seq 00 full: elevation correction
problem.question: Upstream CT-ICP corrects the KITTI HDL-64E elevation angle by +0.205 deg in its KITTI loader and the paper reports KITTI-corrected results; the repository runs used raw scans. How much of the paper-number gap does the correction explain?

variants.label: arch_tuned_all_combined (Table 6 best on seq 00, raw scans)
variants.intent: Table 6 best variant on this sequence.

variants.label: arch_tuned_all_combined (Table 6 best on seq 00, raw scans) + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.
